mapper.select: SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_TYPE, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.CREATED_AT, O.USER_ID, O.DISCOUNT_AMT, (SELECT SUM(UNIT_PRICE * QUANTITY) FROM ORDER_ITEM WHERE ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID) AS totalPrice, MIN(P.PRODUCT_NAME) AS productName, COUNT(OI.ITEM_ID) AS itemCount FROM ORDERS O LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE O.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_TYPE, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.CREATED_AT, O.USER_ID, O.DISCOUNT_AMT ORDER BY O.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_TYPE, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.TOTAL_PRICE, O.DISCOUNT_AMT, O.CREATED_AT, O.USER_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, OI.UNIT_PRICE AS ITEM_PRICE, OI.QUANTITY AS ITEM_COUNT, O.ORDER_TYPE AS ITEM_TYPE, OI.START_DATE, OI.END_DATE FROM ORDERS O INNER JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID INNER JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE O.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND O.USER_ID = #{userId}
